title: The Goodnight Kiss Hunt
markdown:
Penny the pony and Toot the little mouse were snuggled warm and cosy in their little home. Outside, the sun was saying goodbye for the day, and the moon was just peeking out, soft and round and bright. Penny snuggled deeper into her lovely soft straw, feeling warm and safe. Toot snuggled down in his little nest of fluff, his whiskers resting softly.

“Oh, Penny,” whispered Toot, his little whiskers wiggling a little bit. “It’s almost time for our special goodnight kiss. The sweet one.”

Penny nodded slowly. Her long eyelashes blinked softly. “Yes, Toot,” she said. “Our goodnight kiss. It makes our dreams so sweet.”

But as Penny looked around their cosy room, she couldn’t see it anywhere. “Where is our goodnight kiss hiding?” she wondered, her voice soft and low.

Toot’s little pink nose wiggled a lot. “I can’t see it either, Penny. Oh dear, it must have gone somewhere when we weren’t looking.”

Penny blinked her big soft brown eyes. “Let’s look for it together, Toot,” she said, her voice a warm promise. “We will find our special goodnight kiss, I know we will.”

So Penny lowered her gentle head, her coat rustling softly. Toot scampered along beside her, his tiny paws making no sound. Their search was quiet and gentle, like a soft breeze. “Is it under the little rug?” Penny whispered, nudging it softly with her dark nose. They looked underneath, but no, it wasn’t there.

“Maybe it rolled near the warm fire logs?” squeaked Toot, looking with all his might. They looked carefully, but all they found was a little lost button, shiny and blue. Penny nudged the button with her hoof. “Oh, look. A little blue friend,” she said, her voice full of wonder.

“Let’s look under the big soft sofa,” Penny suggested next, her voice sounding like a soft song. They tiptoed over, slow and calm. Penny peered underneath the sofa. Toot scurried ahead.

Penny whispered softly, “Hmm.” She found a fuzzy feather, so light it felt like a little cloud. And Toot found a smooth pebble, cool and nice. “What lovely little treasures we are finding,” Penny said softly, feeling happy with these small surprises.

But still, no goodnight kiss.

Then Toot squeaked, “Look, Penny. Over here. Beside your big warm shoe.”

Penny looked where Toot was pointing. And there it was. Their goodnight kiss, all soft and warm and shining with a soft light, waiting for them. It looked like a tiny bright star, shining just for them, full of sleepy peace.

Penny carefully nudged it with her gentle nose, and it floated softly onto her warm muzzle. Toot, with a little hop of joy, scampered onto Penny’s head, right between her soft ears, settling in for a moment. Penny gave a little happy sigh, feeling all the warmth and love of their home.

“We found it,” she whispered, her voice full of sleepy joy.

Toot snuggled closer, feeling safe and loved. “It was waiting for us right here.”

Penny’s big soft eyes grew heavy, feeling the gentle pull of sleep. Toot yawned a tiny yawn. They were safe and cosy and warm, with their goodnight kiss nearby. Penny settled down slowly onto her soft straw, and Toot snuggled into her soft warm coat, feeling so safe. The moonbeams made soft stripes of light on the floor.

And soon, Penny the pony and Toot the field mouse, with their goodnight kiss keeping them company, their hearts full of peace, drifted off to sleep, dreaming sweet gentle dreams.
